mapper.sql: a.asn_id, a.asn_no, a.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, a.plant_cd, a.supplier_ref, a.ship_date, a.eta_date, a.status, (select count(*) from srm_asn_line l where l.asn_id = a.asn_id)::int as line_cnt, a.open_line_cnt
mapper.select: select from srm_asn a join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = a.cust_id where a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED', 'RECEIVED') and (a.asn_no = #{key} or (a.supplier_ref = #{key} and not exists (select 1 from srm_asn b where b.asn_no = #{key}))) order by a.asn_id limit 2

select l.asn_line_id, l.line_no, l.po_line_id, p.po_id, p.po_no, pl.line_no as po_line_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, pl.item_nm, l.unit_cd, l.qty, r.recv as recv_qty, greatest(l.qty - r.recv, 0) as remain_qty, l.supplier_lot_no, l.mfg_date, l.expiry_date from srm_asn_line l join srm_po_line pl on pl.po_line_id = l.po_line_id join srm_po p on p.po_id = pl.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(x.qty), 0) as recv from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = l.asn_line_id) r where l.asn_id = #{asnId} order by l.line_no
